name: Csc.exe
description: Binary file used by .NET Framework to compile C# code
author: Oddvar Moe

commands.description: Use csc.exe to compile C# code, targeting the .NET Framework, stored in the specified .cs file and output the compiled version to the specified .exe path.
commands.usecase: Compile attacker code on system. Bypass defensive counter measures.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

commands.description: Use csc.exe to compile C# code, targeting the .NET Framework, stored in the specified .cs file and output the compiled version to a DLL file with the same name.
commands.usecase: Compile attacker code on system. Bypass defensive counter measures.
commands.os: Windows vista, Windows 7, Windows 8, Windows 8.1, Windows 10, Windows 11

detection: Csc.exe should normally not run as System account unless it is used for development.
